d: Olive-blonde hair is styled in long, voluminous curls with blunt bangs and two thick ringlets framing the face. The eyes are a matching olive-green with a wide, innocent expression, set on a youthful, child-like face. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a layered sage-green dress featuring a white underskirt, a large orange bow at the chest and waist, and a matching wide-brimmed green hat adorned with red roses, white feathers, and a black bird. Signature accessories include a brown utility belt holding a golden pocket watch and a small brown pouch, paired with dark green tights and matching green shoes with red jewels.
